changelog:
Initial release of openclaw-media-gen (aisa-media-gen):

- Generate images with Gemini 3 Pro Image and videos with Qwen Wan 2.6 using a single API key.
- Provides API and curl examples for image and video generation.
- Includes guidance for Python client usage for both image and video workflows.
- Requires only Python3, curl, and your AISA_API_KEY environment variable.
- Full API documentation references included for quick integration.
summary: Generate images & videos with AIsa. Gemini 3 Pro Image (image) + Qwen Wan 2.6 (video) via one API key.
